comparison.objective: Join a shelf to a cabinet side using two cam locks; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Open cams, align two bolts, close a planar furniture joint, and rotate cams versus support and level a long telescoping rail, actuate spring tabs, engage prongs at two posts, and drive screws.
comparison.success_condition: Both cam heads captured, joint gap at most 0.5 mm, cams locked, and tools returned versus four prongs retained at one rack unit and correct screw holes.
comparison.reason: Both are multi-point assemblies with tool fastening, but cam capture and planar joint closure do not test staged spring latching across separated rack posts.
